page_title: INT 3-1 PAR | Inter v Parma 06/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Rosario Abisso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Substitution. Yann Bisseck walks off the pitch and Tomas Palacios (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' The Inter players are stunned as referee Rosario Abisso changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
85' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Inter, he's going to review using VAR.
85' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) brings an opponent down and Rosario Abisso interrupts the game. A penalty is awarded to Inter!
81' 3 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Matteo Darmian (Inter), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
79' Joaquin Correa (Inter) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
75' Fabio Pecchia prepares a substitution. Matteo Cancellieri is replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).
75' Matteo Darmian (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Bastoni.
74' Substitution. Emanuele Valeri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lautaro Valenti (Parma).
74' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
71' Here is a change. Hakan Calhanoglu is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tajon Buchanan (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
70' That's the end of the game for Marcus Thuram, who is replaced by Joaquin Correa (Inter).
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:1.
66' 3 - 0 Yann Bisseck feeds the ball through to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the left side of the goal! The goalkeeper was helpless. 3:0!
64' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Federico Dimarco (Inter) for a tough tackle.
64' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Federico Dimarco (Inter) took the corner.
60' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Mandela Keita and he is replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
60' Here comes a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny is given a rest as he is replaced by Hernani (Parma).
59' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
59' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Zion Suzuki into a superb diving save to keep it out.
56' No offside! Referee Rosario Abisso points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Inter players celebrate.
54' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Rosario Abisso wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
53' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Nicolo Barella (Inter) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
52' Marcus Thuram (Inter) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
51' Dennis Man (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
48' Good clearance! Federico Dimarco (Inter) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A lofted cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
44' Federico Dimarco (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
42' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Henrikh Mkhitaryan tees up Federico Dimarco (Inter) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:0.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
36' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Yann Bisseck (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
32' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) makes a strong challenge and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul.
31' 64:36 – the latest ball possession ratio.
29' An attempted cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is cleared.
29' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Valentin Mihaila (Parma).

28' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Yann Sommer anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Parma force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

23' What a chance that is! Simon Sohm (Parma) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
21' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
18' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a goal ruled out for offside!
17' A great pass puts Denzel Dumfries (Inter) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Federico Dimarco (Inter) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
14' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
14' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

14' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
13' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Botond Balogh is substituted due to injury. Fabio Pecchia gives a chance to Giovanni Leoni (Parma).
10' Mandela Keita (Parma) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Rosario Abisso ignores the protests.
10' NO PENALTY! Referee Rosario Abisso has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Inter players are incensed.
10' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Inter as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
9' Mandela Keita (Parma) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Inter.
6' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
5' The game is interrupted as Valentin Mihaila (Parma) is flagged offside.
5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Inter was in an offside position.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
2' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
